text: Private fund investor due diligence may follow the evolutionary path of bank risk evaluation, which fifteen years ago operated without uniformity or applicable standards and is today heavily regulated and has evolved into a science.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015

abstract: In analogy to banks' risk evaluation, fifteen years ago banks operated with general risk evaluation strategies but no uniformity and no applicable standards, whereas today banks' risk evaluation is heavily regulated and has evolved into a science. Private fund IDD may follow the same evolution.

value: by analogy to bank risk evaluation
